se4yhsb1.sourceDescription: This stunningly dense Christmas tree with 1300 branch tips and 10 layers possesses a natural beauty and grace and will make a great addition to your holiday decor. The evenly spaced branches along the trunk allow plenty of room for your Christmas decorations, making it easier for hanging your favourite ornaments. Made of high-quality PVC, this easy-to-store Christmas tree can be used again every year and is suitable for use outdoors, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Thanks to its simple plug-in system, this tree is easy to assemble yet durable. This Christmas tree, with a height of 240 cm, will be ideal for creating a unique Christmas atmosphere in your home, garden, office or store! Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation.
